itemNames.1070002: Thin thread. Made by pulling several strands of cobweb, it's also called spider thread. While the thread itself is weak, it's the material that makes silk.

itemNames.1070019: Bundled up wool that's been cut thin. You can spin it with a spinning wheel to make thick thread.
itemNames.1070022: Its official name is Spider Silk. Its soft texture and slight sheen are valued far more than any ordinary fabric. This silk is irregular in its thickness and feels cheap.
